substeps.caption: The enclosure drawn see-through: a CoreXY gantry at the top carries the two-nozzle toolhead, and the bed below it moves only in Z.
The bed rises on its Z screws until the build plate is a first layer below the nozzles.
Printing a vial rack in PETG: the toolhead traces each layer, and the bed steps down a layer at a time as the part grows.
Done. The head parks and the bed drops, so the arm can reach in.
The door opens and the flexible plate comes out with the rack on it, for the arm to take.
